content.bridge_context: Learning a shorthand way to write repeated multiplication.

units.title: Base and Exponent
units.explanation: In 10⁴, 10 is the base and 4 is the exponent (or power). It means 10 * 10 * 10 * 10.

units.title: Laws of Exponents
units.explanation: a^m * a^n = a^(m+n). When multiplying same bases, add the powers.
